author: BBC News
description:
Counterfeit products are being harder to spot and easier to find.
 
Online fakes and so-called dupes can sit just a few taps or clicks away from the real thing.
 
But while the products might give themselves away, the people selling them are harder to catch.
 
BBC Tech Now's Ammie Sekhon explores the tech being deployed by one firm in Edinburgh, Scotland, to identify and remove counterfeit products online.

author: BBC News
description:
The co-pilot who attempted to take control of a Flydubai plane travelling to Israel attacked the pilot with a crash axe, the United Arab Emirates prosecutor general has said.
 
The flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv carrying more than 170 people plunged 17,000ft (5,200m) two and a half hours into its journey, before passengers managed to overpower the attacker and successfully take control of the plane.
 
Two reserve pilots then landed the plane safely in Saudi Arabia.
 
The UAE attorney general told state media that investigations were ongoing to determine the full circumstances and motives of the incident.

description:
In Yemen, the country’s internationally recognised government is fighting with the Houthi rebel movement.
 
Since the informal ceasefire fell apart in July, fighting has intensified - forcing thousands of people from their homes.
 
Many flee to Djibouti, a tiny former French colony that sits just across the water from Yemen. BBC Correspondent Frank Gardner spent a day there reporting across BBC News.

author: BBC News
description:
What began as a routine flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv turned into a fight for survival when one pilot allegedly stabbed another inside the cockpit. 
 
As the aircraft plunged tens of thousands of feet in minutes, passengers and crew were forced into extraordinary action. 
 
This is the story of what unfolded on Flydubai flight FZ1073 and the plumber, dentist, banker and businessman who fought back to prevent disaster.
